deviations: Extended ModalLoopInv with two new fields (eBoxOnlyNeg, eBoxNegWitness) beyond P5a's 3-field bundle, and updated modalStep_preserves_invariant to thread them. This was necessary because modalHintikkaClause (used by hintikkaInv) is vacuously True for all box-shaped formulas regardless of sign, which is insufficient to discharge modalHintikkaSet's second conjunct (boxPos/.pos-box case needs its real persistent clause) and third conjunct (boxNeg/.neg-box witness existence is a genuine existential claim not captured by hintikkaInv at all). Both new fields are proven sound and preserved across modalStepBranch steps.
modalStepBranch_none_saturated is declared private in Completeness.lean; added a local copy (modalLoop_stepBranch_none_saturated) since private declarations are not visible across files.
